commit_message: Complete ADR0126 Timeline foundation and first-release schema on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebuilds the reviewed ADR0126 Timeline foundation on the exact current-main baseline and folds the first-release schema corrections into the same preflight. This establishes the neutral 48 kHz Timeline clock/scheduler/player, stable IDs and persistence, transactional authoring + capability/CLI/MCP surfaces, the six first-release track families, stable Animation Set + MotionSlotId binding, typed multi-key Transform curves, bounded Event payloads, and exact Event crossing/scrub-preview semantics.

The PR remains Draft while production runtime composition, Project Rust integration, dedicated Sequencer authoring/preview, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation continue on this branch.
